page.notes: The text is Syriac (Garshuni or Jacobite Syriac script) and I could not read it letter by letter at this scan resolution, so every Syriac line is marked illegible and only the Latin headings are transcribed. The line count and line lengths are estimates. Paragraph breaks in the Syriac block could not be determined, so the body is given as one paragraph. The bottom-left catchword is Syriac and unreadable. The heading line at the top of the page is Syriac and unreadable. No marginal notes are visible.
